issues.title: Define order and benchmark contract
issues.body:
## Goal
Define order and benchmark contract for Execution Scenario Lab, within 8 hours including checks and documentation.

## Steps
1. Specify side, size, arrival price, time horizon and shortfall sign.
2. Check the product boundary: Compare declared execution schedules under explicit price, spread and impact assumptions. Model-implied shortfall is distinct from realized broker execution; the tool does not claim optimal live fills.
3. Record exact commands, versions, seeds, input hashes, failures and actual time.

## Outputs
Future repository artifact: `docs/CONTRACT.md`. This planning issue does not claim the artifact exists.

## Acceptance checks
All quantities and benchmark timestamps are fixed. Evidence includes a reproducible command or reviewable document; no result is manufactured during planning.

## Dependencies
None beyond activation. Read docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md and docs/IMPLEMENTER_PROTOCOL.md. Prior milestone exits must pass; this candidate remains queued.

## Review evidence
Attach the reviewed diff, exact commands and exit codes, relevant report excerpts, input/config hashes, actual hours and reserve draw. Separate measured outcomes from targets. Done requires review and merge.

## Blocker procedure
Record the smallest failure and missing prerequisite. Keep dependents queued. Use reserve or propose a narrower scope. Unknown rights block distribution; use generated fallback. Escalate budget, intended-use or release changes before crossing them.

Decide product next step for Execution Scenario Lab, within 8 hours including checks and documentation.

## Steps

3. Record exact commands, versions, seeds, input hashes, failures and actual time.
